mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.7% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.7% and the signal is active.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand, which typically leads to higher corporate profits and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS both rising MoM fails to predict positive returns in more than 50% of cases (Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown indicated by INDPRO below 100 for two consecutive months signals reduced corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate above 0.3% (CPIAUCSL MoM) signals persistent inflationary pressures that trigger tighter monetary policy expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL MoM change exceeds 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending that supports higher corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases (Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 4.5% combined with a declining trend signals a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5% and declining.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.
